The deliverable correctly places Miriam Feld in the 'In standard' section and explicitly notes that 'The 2026-08-31 email exchange... is substantive'. She is not reported as having a contact gap or being out of standard.

No other prospects are reported in this category, and Constance Ivers is correctly placed in the 'In standard' section.

No other prospects, such as the Brightwaters or Whitcombes, are incorrectly flagged for this category.
